## AI Engineering Portfolio

19 production-grade AI systems demonstrating real-world engineering. Each project is fully runnable end-to-end. → **[View all projects on GitHub](https://github.com/EricPeter/ai-projects)**

::: {.project-card}
#### [01 — Production RAG with Citations](https://github.com/EricPeter/ai-projects/tree/main/01-production-rag)

PDF Q&A API that returns answers with page-number citations. Implements hybrid search (dense vectors + BM25), cross-encoder reranking, and a LangGraph pipeline. Built for production: chunking, embedding caching, and SQLite-vec for zero-dependency vector storage.

::: {.tech-stack}
[LangGraph]{.tech-tag} [SQLite-vec]{.tech-tag} [sentence-transformers]{.tech-tag} [FastAPI]{.tech-tag} [BM25]{.tech-tag}
:::
:::

::: {.project-card}
#### [02 — Cost-Optimized Model Router](https://github.com/EricPeter/ai-projects/tree/main/02-model-router)

Routes every query to the cheapest model that can handle it — Haiku for simple questions, Sonnet for medium, Opus for complex reasoning. Tracks cost per request in SQLite and exposes real-time Prometheus metrics. Saves up to 10× on API costs.

::: {.tech-stack}
[FastAPI]{.tech-tag} [Prometheus]{.tech-tag} [Anthropic SDK]{.tech-tag} [SQLite]{.tech-tag}
:::
:::

::: {.project-card}
#### [03 — Multi-Agent Research System](https://github.com/EricPeter/ai-projects/tree/main/03-multi-agent-research)

A CrewAI pipeline where a Researcher, Writer, and Fact-Checker collaborate on research reports. The Fact-Checker marks uncertain claims with [UNCERTAIN] markers and pauses for human approval before finalisation. Every agent action is written to a tamper-evident JSONL audit trail.

::: {.tech-stack}
[CrewAI]{.tech-tag} [Anthropic SDK]{.tech-tag} [Audit Trail]{.tech-tag}
:::
:::
